These test-only shaders preserve native Canvas source code from checkpoint `542303f`: the water graph and the original flame source, each as a native Canvas receiver. Includes are flattened so the references stay independent of the lit sprite shaders. Modular and wall references use the independent native Canvas fixture with CPU-decoded normals in `native_2d_source_checks.gd`; spatial output is compared with the analytic linear-alpha composite of those native pages. Original artwork stays external and unchanged. The flame/water sources also run uncapped in native HDR to separate half-float storage precision from cap-specific alpha changes. This is a regression oracle, not another production renderer.
